scope: Established stronger static Schur controls and memory-frontier audit; no adaptive/goal-success claim

protocol.selection: farthest point from index0, recomputed/charged for every solve
protocol.tile_selection: largest integer row count allowed by phase-specific named live arrays plus64KiB reserve and4KiB tile-expression guard; no timing-based tuning
protocol.factorization: Fortran core assembled by row blocks; scipy.linalg.cholesky lower=True overwrite_a=True check_finite=False; pointer and sharing verified
protocol.immutable_inputs: X and b shared without a full training-feature copy; temporary selected/remaining feature packs counted
protocol.timing: single native observation each; allocation trace is a separate untimed path

accounting_revision: v2 normalizes common-input backing roots; initial script and failed guards preserved unchanged
